review.why: Plans, sponsors, speaks at or attends events, focusing on choosing events well, booking meetings and following up within two days.
review.summary: Establishes role and goal, then covers portfolio selection (owned, trade show, community), a before, during and after arc, hosting formats, an attending plan and turning recordings into content. It measures qualified meetings and pipeline rather than scans, and lists common mistakes. Deeper files cover webinars, speaking and sponsorship return.
strengths: Most value is in selection and follow-up, not the day itself
Zero-budget attending tactics such as side dinners
cautions: Response-rate and benchmark figures are directional
Four reference files are not read here
